payload.body: Epic build COMPLETE — all direct children done/in_review/cancelled (none open), all on PR #8. The full TypeScript->Rust backend migration plus the realtime calls control plane (FR-276: FR-281..FR-290) are merged on rust-rewrite-foundation and gated green (962 workspace Rust tests + 420 TS + Swift 178 + Android :frick; clippy -D warnings + fmt clean; the 3 calls conformance scenarios pass end-to-end). Moving to in_review pending the rust-rewrite-foundation -> main review/merge. Residual non-blocking polish is tracked: a stale product-test call-schema fixture (spawned task), LiveKit deployment infra (ops), and manual native-SDK call acceptance (documented checklist).
